You are auditing a design-system handover repo at /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/Zimmermann-Handover. This is READ-ONLY: do not edit any files. Audit the specs, the handover index, and design-to-handover coverage. Return a detailed findings report.

Context: This is the "DDP Design OS". Specs live in 02-design/specs/{components,screens,flows,templates}. The handover entry point is 05-handover/index.md (managed by /handover). Specs use a "two-layer model": a Design layer (designer-owned) and a Platform layer (dev-owned, added after handover) with implementation notes / component mapping / deviations. Each spec has a changelog block at the top. Target stacks: web, react.

Scope (read thoroughly):
- 05-handover/index.md (full file) and 05-handover/platform/ (ios/android/web guardrail docs)
- Every file under 02-design/specs/ (components, screens, flows, templates)
- Cross-reference: the element folders in 02-design/library/elements/ and prototypes in 02-design/prototypes/

Analyze for:
1. Broken/stale links: every relative link in 05-handover/index.md — does the target file actually exist? List each broken link. Same for spec: frontmatter paths in prototype intent.md files and any cross-references in specs.
2. Coverage matrix: build a table of components. For each library element, does it have (a) a component spec, (b) a contract entry, (c) a prototype? Flag elements with a library folder but no spec, specs with no matching element, and interactive components with no prototype (CLAUDE.md requires prototypes for anything with interaction/state/animation/flow).
3. Two-layer model adherence: do specs actually contain BOTH a Design layer and a Platform layer section? Since stacks are web+react and this is heading to build, is the Platform layer populated or empty/placeholder? Note specs missing accessibility notes or prototype links.
4. Consistency: changelog block format consistent across specs (per CLAUDE.md: date, trigger, one-line summary, last 5 shown)? Any specs missing changelog? Screen specs vs component specs structure consistency. Templates coverage.
5. Handover completeness for a dev: is index.md actually a usable single entry point? What would a developer be unable to find? Note missing sections (e.g., how to run/build, token reference link, contract link, environment/setup).

Return a ranked findings report (most severe first). For each: short title, severity (High/Med/Low), concrete evidence (file paths, quoted lines), why it matters for an engineering handover, suggested fix. Include the full coverage matrix as a table. Be concrete — I will relay to the user.

## Design layer

### Overview

| Footer | `40000257:7539` | 484px | `<zimm-footer>` |

- Component: `<zimm-navigation>` at Desktop breakpoint (1024px+)
- Full-width, white background. Nav items: New, Clothing, Accessories, Collections, Z.Immerse. Right side: Search input, Profile/Wishlist/Bag icons
- Internal padding: `--zimm-scale-1000` (40px) horizontal, `--zimm-scale-1200` (48px) vertical

**Logo masthead**
- Full-width white region with the large-format ZIMMERMANN wordmark pinned bottom-left

- Wordmark dimensions: 631×74.5px (desktop), 223px wide (mobile). Rendered via `<zimm-logo-masthead>`

- Spec: [02-design/specs/components/logo-masthead.md](../components/logo-masthead.md)

**Main content**

- No structural constraints beyond full width. Figma shows 141px minimum. Actual height driven by content
- Not a component. This is a content slot filled by each page type

**Footer**
- Component: `<zimm-footer>`
- Full-width dark footer, self-contained and responsive. No template-level styling required
- Spec: [02-design/specs/components/footer.md](../components/footer.md)

### Layout

**Vertical stack**
- All regions: `display: block; width: 100%`
- Inter-region gap: 12px (Figma layout gap, applies between all 4 regions)

Apply `.zimm-grid` to any container within the template that requires column alignment. Not set at template level, used by page content inside `.region-content`.

I have all the evidence I need. Here is the full audit.

---

# Zimmermann Handover Audit — Findings Report

## Framing (read first)

`05-handover/index.md` line 19 declares **`Build Status: Design & Requirements Stage`** — the repo is **not** marked "Ready for Build". So empty platform layers and some gaps are expected for the stage. That said, the audit shows exactly which gaps must close before this is a clean engineering handover. The single biggest issue is **spec coverage: only 15 of 27 catalogued components have a design spec.** Link integrity of `index.md` itself is otherwise very good (all 60+ component/spec/contract/prototype links resolve; only the requirements folder links break).

Scope covered: `05-handover/index.md`, `05-handover/platform/web/*`, all 16 component specs, 1 template spec, the 27-entry contract, all 3 prototype `intent.md` files, `prototypes/INDEX.md`, and all 28 library element folders.

---

## Ranked findings

### 1. Twelve of 27 components have no spec (HIGH)
The contract (`02-design/library/contract/zimm-contract.js`) and library each define 27 components, but `02-design/specs/components/` holds only 16 `.md` files (one of which, `link.md`, maps to no component). Net: **12 catalogued components ship JS + a contract entry + an index row but zero design spec.**

Missing specs (element folder + contract entry exist, spec absent):
`card-baseline`, `cat-links-aside`, `hero-blocks`, `input-action`, `page-toolbar`, `product-detail`, `product-detail-gallery`, `product-detail-options`, `search`, `search-overlay`, `select`, `toolbar-category`.

Evidence: In `05-handover/index.md` the Spec column is blank for these rows, e.g. line 59 `| \`zimm-select\` | ...select.js | | draft |` and line 75 `| \`zimm-search-overlay\` | ...search-overlay.js | | placeholder |`.

Why it matters: several are highly interactive — `zimm-product-detail-options` (size select, add-to-bag, wishlist, accordions), `zimm-search-overlay` (open/close/escape/animation, and flagged `status: placeholder`, "visual design pending"), `zimm-select`, `zimm-search`. A developer has the web-component source and the API contract but no design intent, token rationale, states, responsive behaviour, or a11y notes to build against.
Suggested fix: run `/extract` to generate specs for the 12, prioritising the interactive molecules/organism (`product-detail`, `product-detail-options`, `product-detail-gallery`, `search-overlay`, `toolbar-category`, `search`, `select`).

### 2. PLP and PDP template prototypes have broken `spec:` frontmatter and no spec (HIGH)
The two commerce page templates point at spec files that do not exist:
- `02-design/prototypes/templates/product-listing/intent.md` line 2: `spec: templates/template-product-listing.md` → `02-design/specs/templates/template-product-listing.md` **missing**.
- `02-design/prototypes/templates/product-detail/intent.md` line 2: `spec: screens/product-detail.md` → `02-design/specs/screens/product-detail.md` **missing** (also points into `screens/` while `stage: template`).

Only `templates/main/intent.md` resolves (`template-main-large-screen.md` exists). The `screens/` and `flows/` spec folders contain only `.gitkeep`.

Why it matters: the Product Listing and Product Detail pages are the core of the site. Their prototypes render, but the prototype→spec link dangles and there is no spec layer at all — so measurements are explicitly "not confirmed from Figma" (stated in both intent files) with nothing downstream to confirm them into. This also violates the repo's Missing Path Protocol (dangling `spec:` refs).
Suggested fix: create `template-product-listing.md` and a product-detail template/screen spec (decide `templates/` vs `screens/` and make the frontmatter match), then re-run `/handover` so the Templates table picks them up.

### 3. `index.md` is not a self-sufficient dev entry point — no run/build/setup section (MED-HIGH)
`grep` across `05-handover/` finds no "how to run", local-server, `npx`, prerequisites, or getting-started guidance, and there is no root `package.json`.

Why it matters: the deliverables are ES-module web components, an HTML catalog (`02-design/catalog/index.html`), and HTML prototypes — all of which need a static server to run (ES modules fail on `file://`). `02-design/library/contract/validate.mjs` needs Node. A developer opening `index.md` has no instruction on how to serve the catalog/prototypes, what Node version to use, or how to run the validator. `index.md` links source files and the catalog but never says how to view them.
Suggested fix: add a "Getting started / running locally" section to the handover (serve command for catalog + prototypes, Node requirement for `validate.mjs`, where `common.css` must be reachable). Consider a one-line note that specs use a two-layer model and where devs write the platform layer.

### 4. `03-requirements/` folder is entirely absent; three index links are broken (MED)
`05-handover/index.md` lines 135-137 link `../03-requirements/epics/`, `/features/`, `/stories/`. All three 404 — `find 03-requirements` returns nothing; the whole top-level folder is missing. The counts are listed as 0, so content-wise this is empty-by-design, but the links are dead and a CLAUDE.md-mandated top-level folder is gone.
Why it matters: broken links in the canonical entry point erode trust in it; per CLAUDE.md, `03-requirements` is a top-level structural folder.
Suggested fix: recreate `03-requirements/{epics,features,stories}/` (with `.gitkeep`) or have `/handover` render these rows without hyperlinks until the folder exists.

### 5. `link.md` spec is orphaned; `link/` element is a stub (MED)
`02-design/specs/components/link.md` documents the `.zimm-text-link-lg` CSS utility class. It is **not referenced anywhere in `05-handover/index.md`** and appears in no contract entry. Its element folder `02-design/library/elements/link/` contains only `demo.html` — no `zimm-link.js` (confirmed: it is the sole element folder with no JS module).
Why it matters: the spec self-declares `Pattern type: CSS class (not a component)` (line 13), so the missing JS/contract is intentional — but because `index.md` never links `link.md`, a developer using the handover as the single entry point will never discover the sanctioned link styling, and may reinvent it. The stray `link/demo.html` with no module also reads as an abandoned extraction.
Suggested fix: add a "CSS utility patterns" row/section to `index.md` linking `link.md`; either remove the empty `link/` element folder or note it as demo-only.

### 6. All 16 platform layers are empty; template wording has drifted (MED — expected for stage, but a build blocker)
Every spec's Platform layer is a placeholder. Counts: 14 say `[Empty until a developer picks this up.]`, plus one-off variants in `mega-menu.md` (`*To be completed after handover...*`), `product-showcase-blocks.md` (`*Pending handover.*`), and `card-editorial.md` (`_To be completed by the dev team after handover._`).
Why it matters: consistent with `Build Status: Design & Requirements Stage`, so not a defect per se — but since target stacks are web+react and this is heading to build, note that no React/component-mapping or deviation notes exist yet in any spec. The four different placeholder strings indicate `/extract` template drift across dates (a managed-file consistency issue).
Suggested fix: none required until build begins; when standardising, normalise the placeholder string via the `/extract` template.

### 7. `card-editorial.md` embeds a broken screenshot (LOW-MED)
`02-design/specs/components/card-editorial.md` line 107: `![Cards - editorial](assets/2026-07-15-screenshot.png)` resolves to `02-design/specs/components/assets/2026-07-15-screenshot.png`, which does not exist (that folder holds only `2026-07-14-link.png`). The actual image is at `02-design/library/elements/card-editorial/assets/2026-07-15-screenshot.png`.
Why it matters: the only visual reference in the editorial-card spec won't render. Every other spec uses the working `../../library/elements/<name>/assets/...` pattern.
Suggested fix: change the path to `../../library/elements/card-editorial/assets/2026-07-15-screenshot.png`.

### 8. Spec structural inconsistencies — missing sections and boundary markers (LOW)
- **Missing `### Prototype` section** (part of the design layer): `card-editorial.md`, `footer.md`, `link.md`, `product-showcase-blocks.md`, `text-input.md`.
- **Missing closing `<!-- /design-layer -->` marker** (the dev "do not edit above" boundary): `card-editorial.md`, `mega-menu.md`, `product-showcase-blocks.md`.
- **`text-input.md` line 12 declares `Stack: web`** only, while every other spec and the handover declare `web, react`.
- Two visible spec-template generations: older specs use Overview/Tokens/Interactive/States/Variants/Layout/Components/Accessibility/Prototype; newer ones (`text-input`, `card-editorial`, `disclaimer`, `mega-menu`, `product-showcase-blocks`) use Attributes/Typography/Slots/Custom properties/Responsive.
Why it matters: the missing close markers weaken the ownership boundary the two-layer model relies on; the `web`-only stack on `text-input` is likely an oversight.
Suggested fix: re-run `/extract` on the affected specs to restore the standard section set and markers; correct the `text-input` stack.

### 9. Stale reference to removed `zimm-product-card` (LOW)
`index.md` changelog (line 4) records "product-card removed", but `add-to-wishlist.md` line 23 still reads "Used within `<zimm-product-card>` and directly on product pages." No such element/contract entry exists.
Why it matters: points a developer at a component that isn't in the system.
Suggested fix: update the sentence to reference `zimm-card-baseline` / product pages.

### 10. Prototype "template" stage not in declared vocabularies; cosmetic drift (LOW)
`prototypes/INDEX.md` line 7 lists stage values `interaction | flow | tokens | animation` (omits `template`), yet all three registered prototypes use `template` (lines 12-14). `platform/web/annotation-template.md` line 4 omits it too. (CLAUDE.md does permit `template`, so the code is fine; the legends are stale.) Separately, `platform/web/README.md` lines 2/36 reference a skill named `/extract-specs`, but the current skill is `/extract`. Also 4 specs use ASCII `->` vs 12 using unicode `→` in the "Full history" line (both allowed by conventions — purely cosmetic).
Suggested fix: add `template` to the INDEX/annotation legends; rename `/extract-specs` → `/extract` in the web platform README.
